- Security & compliance: attached is our current security packet (Aurora-Security-Packet-v1.pdf) and a small worksheet for any redline requests (redlines-request.xlsx).

3) I’ll open a mutual action plan once we lock dates.

Hi Aditya —

Sorry for the delay — legal and infra are swamped this week. Two quick items that are blockers for us right now:

1) SOC 2 evidence: can you share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or an executive summary? The packet is useful but our procurement wants the formal report.
2) Data retention / residency: we need confirmation that customer logs can be retained for 90 days max and stored in a US region (us-east-1 preferred).

If you can send the SOC 2 report and a short note confirming retention/residency, I can move this to legal and get back to you on timing. Otherwise happy to jump on a quick call with Monica to close these.

Thanks —

- SOC 2 report: attaching a SOC 2 Type II executive summary (Aurora-SOC2-FAQ.pdf) and a link to the full report for authorized reviewers only — please let me know who in legal should receive the full document and I’ll initiate access.
